title: Sales Assistant (General) / Cashier
description:
Summary
Run the POS and cash desk. Fast, accurate, friendly service. Protect cash and records.
Duties and Responsibilities
Open/close till; manage float; process cash/EFTPOS/mobile; receipts.
Refunds/voids per policy; daily Z-report; cash-up and handover.
Queue control; phone/online orders; keep counter tidy.
Idle-time tasks:
sweep/mop FOH floors, wipe tables/counters, empty bins.
Restock napkins/condiments/packaging; polish cutlery and glassware.
Front stock shelves/fridges; do quick cycle counts; flag low stock for ordering.
Assist with basic table clearing/reset (no alcohol service unless trained/authorized).
Follow cleaning roster, SDS, and PPE when using chemicals.
Report variances, incidents, hazards immediately.
Job Requirements
1+ year cashier/POS experience.
Good with numbers; accurate data entry; basic Excel.
Clear communicator; honest and polite.
Grooming & Hygiene (FOH):
clean pressed uniform each shift (bring a spare shirt), daily shower & deodorant, fresh breath, no strong perfume/cologne, hair neat/tied back, short clean nails, minimal jewellery, closed non-slip shoes, no smoke/vape odour. Manager may stand you down to correct.
Others
Hours/breaks as per PNG law; do not leave the till unattended.
Fit to lift up to 15–20kg for restocking; nights/weekends/PH as rostered.
Cross-train for host/runner duties as needed; reports to Restaurant Manager.
